title: Winner-Path Complexity and Score Margins in a Two-Criterion Entropy-Weighted Orthopair Model — V22 Reproducibility Archive
description: Curated computational companion to manuscript V22, Winner-Path Complexity and Score Margins in a Two-Criterion Entropy-Weighted Orthopair Model. Contains frozen derived aggregate inputs, WA/WG/cosine-TOPSIS grid comparisons for eleven encodings of six official-data domains, the post-hoc housing mechanism analysis, and specifically identified numerical certificates. The claim maps separate grid evidence from continuum certificates and analytical proofs. This is not a complete archive of every historical calculation, a proof-assistant verification, completed human specialist review, or journal publication. V18 is retained separately as historical material. CC0 applies only to original material; derived third-party data retain the source conditions in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. No publisher PDFs, private manuscript/development packages, credentials or dependency binaries are redistributed. OpenAI ChatGPT/Codex assisted literature review, mathematical development, drafting, code and checking. New V22 human scientific approval is not inferred from automated verification.
